system_prompt_style.note: Base prompt string plus conditionally appended few-shot section assembled at runtime.

env_context_strategy.note: Semantic/vector index (Voyage embeddings) plus agent-driven search actions (FindClass, FindFunction, ViewCode).

context_compaction.note: MessageHistoryGenerator supports 'messages', 'summary', 'react'; default configs use 'messages' (full history).

tool_call_format.note: tool_call is default in shipped configs; 'react' format also selectable (LLMResponseFormat).

tool_schema_source.note: Schemas come from Pydantic ActionArguments models.

protocol_standardization.note: Actions registered directly as Python classes; no MCP/A2A client visible in provided evidence.

loop_primitives.note: MCTS default; RunTests feeds results back; discriminator selects among up to five candidate solutions.

planning_granularity.note: Plan is an action/state type, not a persisted structured plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
The framework includes a SWE-Agent
for adaptive exploration, a Value Agent for iterative feedback, and a Discrimi-
nator Agent that facilitates multi-agent debate for collaborative decision-making.
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off: action agent -> value agent -> discriminator debate; discriminator stage itself is a debate among n_agents.

delegation_mechanism.note: Components are fixed modules; no agent spawns another agent for a subtask.

human_in_loop.note: Run loop executes actions without approval gates; Streamlit app is a viewer.

short_term_state.note: Node objects carry file_context, action_steps, completions, reward, terminal flags beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A Voyage AI API key from [voyageai.com](https://voyageai.com) to use the pre-embedded vector stores for SWE-Bench instances.
long_term_memory.note: Persistent per-repo embedding index reused across runs; not agent-written memory.

state_persistence.note: Trajectory persisted each iteration via maybe_persist and reconstructable into a runnable loop/tree.

self_verification.note: ValueFunction and AgentDiscriminator are LLM judges; feedback generator gives hindsight self-critique; testbed runs tests.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
Nodes can
be expanded using value function feedback from future actions.
retry_policy.note: Re-expansion continues until iteration/expansion caps; not a fixed whole-task retry count.

rollback.evidence_quote:
a dynamic code environment with a flexible state-space and a git-
like commit tree structure. This design facilitates efficient backtracking to previous states
rollback.note: Backtracking via cloned file contexts per node (parent.file_context.clone()).

termination_condition.note: Also max_cost check and nodes[-1].is_terminal() from Finish/Reject.

timeouts.note: Only iteration and cost caps found in provided evidence; no timeout setting visible.

execution_isolation.note: Repos cloned to local dirs and edited in-process; optional remote testbed for test execution.

filesystem_access.note: Edit actions operate through the Repository/FileContext abstraction rooted at the cloned repo.

network_policy.note: No network restriction configuration present in the evidence.

permission_model.note: Only the configured action list is executable; no shell escape hatch in the default action set.
